data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: Visual Basic provides built-in functions for efficiently searching, formatting, and manipulating text: 1. Case Modification: UCase() converts letters to uppercase to standardize text. 2. Whitespace Management: Trim(), LTrim(), and RTrim() remove unwanted spaces. 3. Financial Formatting: FormatCurrency() formats numbers as localized currency values. 4. Character Manipulation: StrReverse() reverses text, while Split() separates a sentence into an array of words. 5. String Comparison: Option Compare Text enables case-insensitive comparisons, while Option Compare Binary distinguishes between uppercase and lowercase.
